description: Print the current page to a PDF file.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

margin.description: Page margin in inches (default 0.4). Pass a single number (all sides) or an object {top,bottom,left,right}.

pageRanges.description: Page ranges to print (e.g. '1-5'). Leave empty for all pages.

name: browser_pdf
